title_ar: الشيخ الددو يحاضر بدار الشباب القديمة عن "زمن المبشرات"
title_en: Sheikh al-Dedew Lectures at the Old Youth House on "The Time of Glad Tidings"
body_ar: نظمت جمعية المستقبل للتربية والثقافة والتعليم محاضرة فكرية تحت عنوان: زمن المبشرات بين نصوص الوحي ومعطيات الواقع مساء اليوم الأربعاء 24 صفر 1433هـ الموافق: 18/01/2012 بدار الشباب القديمة مع فضيلة الشيخ العلامة محمد الحسن ولد الددو رئيس الجمعية، وسط حضور كبير من قبل ساكنة نواكشوط، حيث عرفت دار الشباب توافد المئات من مختلف مشارب المجتمع قبيل صلاة العصر، وشهدت جنباتها اكتظاظا بالوافدين مع اقتراب الليل بعد أن امتلأت المدرجات بالجمهور، إذ جلست الجماهير خارج المدرج تلتقط ما يصلها من صوت فضيلة الشيخ خلال محاضرته التي انتهت مع صلاة المغرب. وفي بداية حديثه تناول فضيلة الشيخ حفظه الله الأقدار التي تجري بها أحوال الناس، مبينا أن الله تعالى جعل تلك الأقدار خاضعة لحكمة بالغة تتماشى والعدل الذي عليه قامت السماوات والأرض، ثم تطرق الشيخ لسنن الله الماضية، مؤكدا أن تلك السنن الثابتة ينبغي أن تكون الموجه الذي يعتمد عليه من يتطلع لقراءة المستقبل وتوقع الأحداث، ثم قام الشيخ بتعديد بعض من سنن الله تعالى في الكون والحياة وفي الإنسان. وقد نبه الشيخ إلى أن الله تعالى يبتلي المؤمنين ويمتحنهم حتى يميز الخبيث من الطيب، لكنه تعالى يمنح للمؤمنين مقابل ذلك مثبتات تربط على قلوبهم وتزكي أعمالهم وتزيد من ثقتهم بنصره القريب رغم المحن والمصائب التي يختبرهم بها، وقد اعتبر الشيخ أن الصراع بين الحق والباطل صراع دائم ما دامت الدنيا، لكن جولة الباطل لا تطول حتى تأتي الصولة المباركة للحق وأهله الذين يملؤون الأرض عدلا بعد أن ملئت جورا. للمتابعة اضغط هنا:
body_en:
The Future Association for Upbringing, Culture and Education organised an intellectual lecture under the title "The Time of Glad Tidings: Between the Texts of Revelation and the Data of Reality" on the evening of Wednesday 24 Safar 1433 AH, corresponding to 18/01/2012, at the Old Youth House, with the eminent scholar Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan Ould al-Dedew, the association's president, amid a large attendance on the part of the residents of Nouakchott. The Youth House saw hundreds arriving from every walk of society shortly before the afternoon prayer (ʿaṣr), and its precincts were thronged with new arrivals as night drew on, the tiers having filled with the audience, so that the crowds sat outside the hall catching what reached them of the Sheikh's voice during his lecture, which ended with the sunset prayer (maghrib).

At the beginning of his talk the Sheikh, may God preserve him, took up the decrees (aqdār) by which the circumstances of people run their course, explaining that God Most High has made those decrees subject to a consummate wisdom (ḥikmah) in keeping with the justice upon which the heavens and the earth are founded. The Sheikh then turned to God's established ways in the past (sunan), affirming that these constant ways ought to be the guide relied upon by whoever looks to read the future and anticipate events; and he then enumerated some of God Most High's established ways in the cosmos, in life and in the human being.

The Sheikh pointed out that God Most High tries the believers and tests them so as to distinguish the corrupt from the good, but that in return He grants the believers things that steady them, binding fast their hearts, purifying their deeds and increasing their confidence in His help, which is near, despite the trials and afflictions by which He tests them. The Sheikh held that the struggle between truth and falsehood is a perpetual struggle for as long as this world lasts, but that falsehood's turn does not run long before there comes the blessed ascendancy of the truth and of its people, who fill the earth with justice after it has been filled with oppression.

flags.context: زمن المبشرات بين نصوص الوحي ومعطيات الواقع — the lecture title
options: the true dreams that remain of prophethood
flags.note: al-mubashshirāt has a narrow technical sense in hadith — the true dreams said to be all that remains of prophethood — and a broad sense of signs that foretell good. The report gives no indication which the Sheikh intended, and the body's content (God's ways in history, the eventual ascendancy of truth) points to the broad sense, so the broad rendering is used. Not in the glossary; the Sheikh's office should settle it, since the lecture itself is audio.

flags.arabic: سنن الله الماضية / سنن الله تعالى في الكون
flags.context: ثم تطرق الشيخ لسنن الله الماضية ... بعض من سنن الله تعالى في الكون والحياة وفي الإنسان
options: God's established ways (in creation and in history)
the divine patterns / laws of history
flags.note: HOMONYM WARNING. The glossary carries سنن (sunan) as 'the sunnah acts' in the field of worship. That entry must not be applied here: sunan Allāh are the constant patterns God has set in creation and history, and have nothing to do with recommended acts of worship. Rendered 'God's established ways' throughout and deliberately not bracketed with the glossary term.

flags.context: تناول فضيلة الشيخ حفظه الله الأقدار التي تجري بها أحوال الناس
flags.note: Style guide section 13 lists qaḍāʾ/qadar as a pending glossary addition in its theological sense, distinct from both senses of qaḍāʾ already in the glossary (judicial ruling; making up a missed act of worship). Flagged rather than assumed. Note also that this is creedal, not legal, material: style guide section 8 applies, and nothing here is a ruling on an act.

flags.arabic: جولة الباطل لا تطول ... يملؤون الأرض عدلا بعد أن ملئت جورا
flags.context: the closing sentence of the report
options: render as the report's own prose, with the allusions noted
flags.note: Two well-known formulae, quoted by the news desk without attribution: 'falsehood's turn does not run long' is proverbial, and 'fill the earth with justice after it has been filled with oppression' is the wording of the widely transmitted reports about the awaited Mahdi. Whether the Sheikh used the second phrase in that specific sense, or the news desk supplied it, cannot be determined from a summary. Nothing has been added to the English.

translator_notes: A news-desk report, not a text by the Sheikh. All content attributed to him is summary at second hand.
The CMS timestamp, 18 January 2012, is a bulk-upload date; the body dates the lecture to the evening of Wednesday 24 Safar 1433 / 18 January 2012.
The association is named here 'for Upbringing, Culture and Education' and in record 789 'for Calling to Islam, Culture and Education'. The inconsistency is the source's and has not been harmonised.
